verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, so RFE/NOID response work is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the pack mentions Requests for Evidence or Notices of Intent to Deny. The nearest items are generic claims of 'end-to-end' support, 'government inquiries and compliance matters involving USCIS' for businesses, and 'complex litigation.' These are adjacent services, not documented RFE/NOID response work.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings
